title: Clo Digital Fashion Weekend 2024
description:
Check out our Digital Fashion Weekend event highlights! Discover the experiences shared by our visitors. From November 2-3rd, this event attracted hundreds of visitors eager to explore the CLO Ecosystem in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

Featuring #createwithclo works by local Vietnamese talent and highlighting our CLO Creator Collective including Stephy Fung (@stephyfung), Vesna Stawa (@orchidea3d), Patricia Nahorniac (@deadstockbloom), Greta Staude (@fashionx3d), Calvyn Justus (@calvynjustus) and Alfie Taylor (@akjt11). 

We're excited to host the next event! Share your city suggestions in the comments.

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord-
